input_authority.test_pressure: Chosen conventional bench condition, not engine boost or cylinder pressure
input_authority.temperature_and_pressure: Chosen laboratory reference, not measured conditions
input_authority.throat_and_lifts: Existing four-valve design V2 assumptions, not OEM metrology
input_authority.receiver_bore: Documentary M64 baseline hypothesis, not validation of the scanned head scale
input_authority.gamma_and_R: Calorically perfect dry-air normalization; not a combustion model

geometry_requirements: One connected gas volume with full chamber and bore receiver
Both intake valves at declared lift, seats and guides subtracted from gas
Exhaust valves closed and spark-plug boundary sealed
No outlet substituted for the two intake throats
Native and persisted topology, boundary labels and leakage checks accepted
Identical entry radius, receiver, conditions and reference area for A-B comparisons

references.scope: Bench preparation, sealing, matching bore fixture, entry radius, comparable conditions and 28 inH2O; not the geometry or performance of this head
Isentropic ideal-gas mass-flow normalization and sonic maximum; not actual head flow
